newFinding.rawBody:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Defer layout application while disabled**

When the host is rebound while `FightMatchResponsiveLayout.enabled` is false, `Bind` correctly skips `Subscribe()` but still calls `Apply()`. An invalid safe-area sample then invokes `Gate(false)`, reactivating the diagnostic, locking the battle `CanvasGroup`, emitting `ValidityChanged(false)`, and cancelling the Host pointer even though the component remains disabled; because it is unsubscribed, the gate can also remain stuck until re-enable. Defer sampling until `OnEnable` when `isActiveAndEnabled` is false so the disable cleanup remains silent and released.
